title: Fuel Oil

onscreen_lines.desc: B10 Bioheating Fuel Oil - Tank Wagon (TW) Delivery (less than 5,500 gallons to a single tank location) #2 Grade, B10 Blend - Minimum 10% biodiesel by volume with the remainder being Grade #2 Fuel Oil. Ultra-Low Sulfur content (15 ppm or less). Fuel must be visually free of undissolved water, sediment, and suspended matter. Winterization additives may be required during cold weather months to ensure equipment operation. Please indicate in dollars and cents the price to be charged above or below the OPIS Gross Wholesale B10 SME Biodiesel ULSHO Rack Average Price. Bidder must clearly indicate (+) for pricing above or (-) for pricing below the OPIS benchmark. Published prices per barrel must be converted to price per gallon by the bidder prior to calculating and applying bid rate against the benchmark.
